title: orch agent adapters v1 (workspace/src/orch/agents.json)
description: The one place that knows agent tools: how to find one, the argv for a fresh or resumed run (oneshot or live in tmux), how a live run takes input and says it is idle, how session ids are obtained, and capability flags that switch features on or off (the generic adapter is the floor: everything works with all flags false). Only adapters.py reads it. Argv items may hold the placeholders {prompt} {session} {new_session} {orch_hooks_file} {allow}; the string "{command}" / "{interactive}" in place of an argv means the user's [agents.<name>] command, split with shlex. A oneshot argv without {prompt} gets the prompt appended (prompt_via arg). User entries in .orch/config.toml are described by $defs/user_config (local-files.md).

argv.description: Argument safety (prevents bugs, not agents): {prompt} is its own item AFTER a '--' item, so text starting with '-' is never read as an option (or the prompt goes on stdin: prompt_via stdin and no {prompt}). {session} is bound as --flag={session}, follows its flag, or is a positional before '--'; session ids never start with '-' (ticket.schema.json sessions[].id). The order is checked by validate.py and by adapters.py at load.

signal.description: hook:<Event> = the tool's own hook calls `orch run event`; orch:run-done = the agent runs `orch run done` itself.

label.description: Shown to people. "{name}" = the user's entry name.

env_any.description: Any set = orch runs inside this tool (labels agent:<name>).

resume.description: null = cannot resume: every run starts fresh from the ticket and its summary.

stream_args.description: Optional. Added for a machine-readable event stream.

allow_args.description: Optional. Added to retry with a tool allowed ({allow}).

send.description: How text goes in: tmux paste-buffer -p, then Enter.

interrupt_keys.description: tmux send-keys names that stop the current turn.

events.description: Name of the event normaliser for this tool's transcript/stream, or null (board from ticket changes only).

live.description: null = no live mode; runs are oneshot.

hooks.description: Tool hook event -> the orch command it runs. orch writes them into a per-run file ({orch_hooks_file}).

id.description: chosen-by-orch = orch passes {new_session}; from-output = read from the run's output; none = no sessions.

hand_started.description: How a session started by hand reports its id, or null.

parse.description: For from-output: name of the output parser.

interactive_tmux.description: For generic: true only when the user entry sets interactive.

instructions.description: File the tool reads by itself (AGENTS.md).

instructions_link.description: File -> line it must contain, e.g. TOOL.md -> @AGENTS.md (the file this tool reads at start).

files.description: Files orch prepares so this tool finds AGENTS.md and the skills.

user_config.description: The agent part of .orch/config.toml, parsed (other tables belong to add-ons and are not checked here).

agent.description: Which agent does the work here: an adapter name or an [agents.<name>] entry.

adapter.description: Built-in adapter whose rules apply, e.g. generic.

command.description: Oneshot command line ({prompt} optional; appended when missing). Used without confirmation; the first use on a machine prints one notice line.

interactive.description: Optional command that starts the tool interactively (live runs in tmux).
